purpose: Lightweight autonomous exact reconstruction and reusable knowledge
priority: User lightweight workflow overrides older broad CI, prose hash, repeated audit and reporting requirements.
workflow: compile and compare affected complete scope

validation.ordinary_notes: diff review only; no native replay, full CI or receipt refresh
validation.source: complete affected comparison and known affected consumers
validation.tools: relevant positive/negative cases and bounded real smoke
validation.broad_suite: explicit request or demonstrated impact that cannot be narrowed

prohibited_routine_overhead: mandatory knowledge JSON conversion or promotion
new frameworks, schemas or check families without a concrete need

knowledge.cross_game_access: read-only repository references; scope observations before reuse
knowledge.writing: Fluent, natural, direct prose. No filler, circular repetition, repeated summaries, unnecessary jargon or defensive-claim boilerplate. State relevant uncertainty/scope once.

continuation: Preserve dirty and useful ignored work. Keep a short handoff. A conversation boundary does not imply game completion.
source_freshness: Bind executable inputs and relevant verification settings. Keep ordinary prose and Git metadata as provenance. Declare documents genuinely consumed by builds.
state_isolation: Shared installations; game-owned Wine prefixes, analyzer projects and evidence.
factory_publication: Knowledge notes are freely referenceable; changing automated acceptance rules remains separate reviewed maintenance.
